description: Forty fictional reports for the 320 narrative-led studies. Seeds vary eight times per report. Fourteen-family technical studies are labeled separately.

dreams.text: I was walking in a forest when the path split into three. I could see each direction clearly.
I opened seven doors, but every door took me back to the same quiet room.
I was talking to my mother in a crowd that kept growing larger. I could still see her clearly.
I was swimming under dark water. Then I rose to the surface and saw warm sunlight everywhere.
I was falling from a tower and felt afraid. Someone reached out and caught me. Then I felt safe.
The streets of a city bent sideways around me, then the buildings broke into small pieces.
I climbed a staircase that never ended. Each landing looked exactly like the one before it, over and over.
I only remember a distant light inside a large empty, quiet space. Nothing else was there.
The ceiling was spinning above a table. Its circular motion slowed, but the room stayed sharply visible.
I heard two voices simultaneously, each speaking a different sentence. Neither voice became louder than the other.
Thin rays extended in many directions from the middle of a silent courtyard.
A red landscape suddenly changed into a pale interior. The two places remained visible like overlapping sheets.
The memory was blurry and hazy. I could remember its soft edges but no object clearly.
A glass bridge shattered into separate pieces. The gaps between the pieces kept growing.
A crowd filled the platform. I remained still as small groups separated and gathered again.
My sister stood on the other side of a wide space. A narrow ribbon connected our hands.
Two doors faced each other in a long corridor. Each opening had a different depth.
I was drifting across a river under a pale sky. The current widened and narrowed around me.
The road divided into two beside a small lake. One route curved closely around the other.
The path branched into four on a steep hillside. I could see all four routes at once.
The road split into five among tall walls. A distant light stayed visible beyond the junction.
The path split into three. Beyond one turn I could see cracked glass, and behind another a crowd stood quietly.
I passed through six archways. The openings changed their angle as I approached the far wall.
A corridor bent sideways. The doorframes leaned together without breaking.
I was falling between soft curtains. There was no floor visible and no one reached toward me.
I climbed a bright shaft toward sunlight. The narrow opening widened as I rose.
I was swimming through a dark room. Waves crossed the space while the walls remained in place.
I saw a whirlpool surrounded by small shards. Its edge stayed clear while its center kept turning.
A spiral hung in an empty, quiet space. One edge caught a distant light.
The same shape appeared again and again across a folded sheet. Each repetition moved a little farther away.
An endless corridor opened through seven doors. I kept returning to the same pale starting point.
My friend stood near me while a crowd gathered far away. Two voices were heard simultaneously above us.
I found nothing else was there. A distant light appeared at the edge of the open space.
I was completely alone in an empty space. There was no light and no movement.
The parallel streets became wavy. Their lines crossed a surface that broke into small pieces.
Rain filled a narrow square. Every drop seemed suspended, with small gaps between groups.
My father waited across an open field. He held my hand for a moment before the scene became indistinct.
An indistinct purple shape suddenly changed into another place. The edges stayed blurred throughout.
Two voices sounded at once as a vortex turned between them. The rhythms overlapped without merging.
There were rays converging toward a narrow gap. Beyond it I saw a repeating outline.
